news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Dalton Kincaid hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.desc: Dalton Kincaid hauled on 7-of-8 passing attempts for 38 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Kincaid saw a lot of involvement on Sunday, leading the team with eight targets and seven catches in a win over the Raiders. He wasn't able to do much with his work, however, racking up just 38 scoreless yards over the course of the game. It's encouraging to see them take pains to get him involved, but it's still hard to trust starting him in most fantasy formats at this point in the season.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) out for the season as additional clots are found
news.desc: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) is out for the remainder of the 2026 NFL Season due to blood clots found in his lungs. Hurts was on blood thinners already to treat the clot that was originally found, but will need additional treatment to bring him back to full health. He is expected to make a full recovery.
news.impact: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB. This is obviously extremely serious news for Hurts, his family, and the team, so don't lose sight of that, but it's relieving to hear he should make a full recovery. As for football, it's a big blow for an already struggling Eagles team, who will now proceed with Tanner McKee at QB. Don't be surprised if Cole Payton also sees some run towards the end of the year if things really fly south for the Eagles.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: James Cook III plays well in win Sunday
news.desc: James Cook III rushed the ball 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught three passes for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Cook played great on Sunday. He finished with over 150 total yards and a touchdown against the Raiders, which helped to lead the Bills to a big win on the road. He should continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Josh Allen scores twice in win Sunday
news.desc: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passing attempts for 255 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Allen played a solid game on Sunday, racking up 255 yards and two touchdowns through the air while not turning the ball over at all. He had just one yard on the ground in this game, however, which is extremely uncommon for him, especially after he rushed for over 120 yards last week. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Rams D/ST allows 18 points in loss Sunday
news.desc: The Rams' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 18 points in Sunday's loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense wasn't good on Sunday. They held Arizona's offense to just 18 points, but they were held to just one forced turnover and didn't log even a single sack over the course of the game, which didn't help their own offense. This unit has an easier schedule over the next couple of weeks, but it will still be hard to trust starting them from a fantasy perspective.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Blake Grupe suffers injury in loss Sunday
news.desc: Blake Grupe made his lone field-goal attempt before suffering an injury and leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.impact: The Rams just brought in Grupe to replace the recently-cut Harrison Mevis, but he suffered an injury in his first game as a Ram after taking a big hit on a kickoff. It seems likely that he is going to miss time, which will leave Los Angeles looking for a new kicker before next week.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Colby Parkinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.desc: Colby Parkinson hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 31 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.impact: The veteran was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday. He was able to catch one of their two touchdowns over the course of the afternoon, but they still suffered an ugly loss at the hands of the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't be expecting him to produce in a consistent manner moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Tyler Higbee catches four passes Sunday
news.desc: Tyler Higbee caught four passes for 22 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.impact: Higbee caught four passes over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them, racking up just 22 yards in a loss to the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Blake Corum scores once in loss Sunday
news.desc: Blake Corum rushed the ball nine times for 42 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.impact: Corum got involved on Sunday, seeing 11 total touches in the team's loss to the Cardinals. He was able to get into the end zone on one of his catches, but he still didn't end up with more than just a solid fantasy total. He will likely continue to serve as an involved RB2 behind Kyren Williams moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.desc: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.
